name: pizza-os
description: We are programming an OS - bare metal pizza kernel @ 1MB
author: Vanna Bee, Troy James

scripts.prod: npm run k:build && npm run k:iso && NODE_ENV=production pm2 start server.js --name pizza-os --update-env || pm2 restart pizza-os --update-env
scripts.k:clean: rm -f *.o *.bin *.iso && rm -rf iso/ && rm -f public/pizza-os.bin public/pizza-os.iso
scripts.k:build: nasm -f elf32 boot.asm -o boot.o && g++ -m32 -ffreestanding -O2 -c kernel.cpp -o kernel.o && g++ -m32 -ffreestanding -O2 -c mm.cpp -o mm.o && g++ -m32 -ffreestanding -O2 -c ai_model.cpp -o ai_model.o && ld -m elf_i386 -T linker.ld -o pizza-os.bin boot.o kernel.o mm.o ai_model.o -nostdlib && mkdir -p public && cp pizza-os.bin public/pizza-os.bin && ls -lh pizza-os.bin && grub-file --is-x86-multiboot2 pizza-os.bin && echo '✅ VALID multiboot2'
scripts.k:check: grub-file --is-x86-multiboot2 pizza-os.bin && echo '✅ VALID multiboot2' || echo '❌ INVALID'; echo '---'; readelf -l pizza-os.bin | grep -A2 NOTE || true
scripts.k:qemu: npm run k:build && timeout 8 qemu-system-i386 -kernel pizza-os.bin -nographic -serial mon:stdio
scripts.k:qemu:iso: npm run k:iso && timeout 8 qemu-system-i386 -cdrom pizza-os.iso -boot d -nographic
scripts.restart: npm run k:build && npm run k:iso && pm2 restart pizza-os --update-env
scripts.stop: pm2 stop pizza-os && pm2 delete pizza-os
scripts.status: pm2 status && ls -lh pizza-os.bin public/pizza-os.bin pizza-os.iso public/pizza-os.iso 2>&1 | cat
